div.div:
1 نَثَّ , [aor.
نَثِ3َ ,] inf. n. نثٌّ, It (a bone) distilled, or let flow, the oily matter that was in it: (TA:) [as also مَثَّ]. ―
-b2- نَثَّ, aor.
نَثِ3َ , inf. n. نَثِيثٌ (S, K,) and نَثٌّ; (S;) and ↓ نَثْنَثَ ; (K;) It (a skin) exuded (S, K) the clarified butter that was in it: like مَثَّ. (TA.) ―
-b3- وَأَنْتَ تَنِثُّ نَثِيثَ الحَمِيتِ (accord. to one reading, نَثَّ الحميت, TA) And thou sweatest like the butter-skin. (S, from a trad.) ―
-b4- نَثَّ, aor.
نَثِ3َ , inf. n. نَثِيثٌ, He sweated by reason of fatness, and appeared as though he were anointed: as also مَثَّ: (TA:) or he sweated by reason of his bigness, and his abundance of flesh. (A'Obeyd.) ―
-b5- نَثَّ, (so in the TA,) [aor.
نَثُ3َ ,] or ↓ نَثْنَثَ , (so in the K,) He wiped his hand (K) with a napkin: as also مَثَّ. (TA.) ―
-b6- نَثَّ, [aor.
نَثُ3َ ,] He anointed a wound: as also مَثَّ. (TA.) ―
-b7- نَثَّ, aor.
نَثُ3َ , (S, M, L, K,) and
نَثِ3َ , (M, L, K,) the latter [which deviates from a constant rule] thought by MF to be a mistake, he not knowing any authority for it except the K, and disallowed by the T, (TA,) inf. n. نَثٌّ; (S;) and ↓ نثّث , inf. n. تَنْثِيثٌ; (TA;) He divulged, (S, K,) or spread, dispersed, disseminated, (TA,) news, tidings, or information, (K,) or what was talked of: (S, TA:) like بَثَّ: or he spread what should rather be concealed than spread. (TA.) [See also نَثَا.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
